item.title: City of Amarillo sewer main project impacts traffic until March 6
item.description: The City of Amarillo announced that construction of a new sewer main on Bell Street and Hillside Road is temporarily affecting traffic patterns on Wednesday.

item.title: Ken Paxton sues Children's Health, Dallas-area doctor over gender transition care
item.description: DALLAS, Texas (KETK) -- Ken Paxton has filed a lawsuit against Children's Health and a Dallas-area pediatric doctor, alleging they unlawfully billed Texas Medicaid for gender-related medical treatments provided to minors. item.title: Olympic Zone for Monday Feb. 16, 2026
item.description: On the Olympic Zone for Monday Feb. 16 we take a look at the best moments from Feb. 14, why camaraderie and consistency matters in team pursuit, and more.

item.title: Amarillo College releases result of independent audit
item.description: Amarillo College released the results of an independent audit that was conducted in response to its Vice President being placed on administrative leave pending an investigation related to financial procedures.

item.title: ‘Canadian Bridge’ Fire in Hutchinson County 300 acres burned; 80% contained
item.description: The City of Borger/Hutchinson County OEM reported that crews are responding to a wildfire near the Canadian River Bridge in Hutchinson County Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: '8 Ball' Fire in Armstrong County near Highway 287, 9,000 acres; 40% contained
item.description: The Friends of the Armstrong County Fire Departments issued an advisory that crews were responding to a reported grass fire near Highway 287 and County Road 29 on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: 'Lavender' Fire in Oldham, Potter counties 12,000 acres burned; 20% contained
item.description: Fire crews are working a fire that started in Oldham County and is burning into Potter County.

item.title: Fire warning issued Tuesday after wildfire reported in Beaver County
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a fire warning at around 11:50 a.m. on Tuesday on request by the Oklahoma Forestry Service, after reports of a wildfire three miles northeast of Beaver in Beaver County.

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
